name: Luchino Gregoretti
original_name: ルキーノ・グレゴレッティ
source:
Charming, good-looking and wealthy, Luchino is full of confidence and pride. He is a woman (especially blondes) and gambling lover with expensive tastes. [spoiler]His tendency to order people around comes from his confidence in himself, as well as what he perceives to be the right cause of action. He seems to be impulsive because of his interests, but in actuality, Luchino thinks before he moves ahead.

His favorite colors are black, pink and white, and his favorite foods are minestrone and risotto. When not working, Luchino likes to spend money. Apparently, he arranged the "mafia" outfits for his colleagues. His CR-5 tattoo is located on his right hand.[/spoiler]

[Source: [URL=http://www.tennenouji.net/product/03_luckydog1/charactor/index.html]Luckydog 1 official website[/URL].]
